summary_1line: Krishna arrives at the Kuru court with great honor and urges Dhritarashtra to restrain Duryodhana and make peace with the Pandavas.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna in yellow robes enters the Kuru assembly hall beside Vidura and Satyaki as kings rise from their seats in reverence.
Krishna seated like a sapphire on gold in the silent court while Karna and Duryodhana sit together nearby watching him.
Krishna addresses blind king Dhritarashtra in the hushed assembly, his voice rolling like thunder as sages watch from the sky.
